notes.title: LudoNarraCon + Behind-the-scenes
notes.content:
Hello, detective.

We have big news:
[list]
[*] [b]LudoNarraCon[/b]

You heard it, we'll feature in another incredible festival. This time we're part of LNC's [b]Official Selection[/b]! LNC is a big annual event dedicated to narrative games, and we're thrilled to be a part of it. It's fully digital, and will feature several talks and panels on the vast theme of stories in games. This year, developers of the games from the Official Selection will also be broadcasting. Which leads us to the second news...

[*] [b]Behind-the-scenes[/b]

We at Mother Gaia will be broadcasting brand new content during the event. Save the date: May 11th is the day! You will be able to watch us directly through our Steam page. We're going to give a small peak behind the curtains of this game that is so special to us, and we also want to have a casual chat while showing some gameplay.
[/list]
* This event was previously scheduled to 4pm on May 10th, but had to be postponed to May 11th!

[b]As the old saying goes: don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't, and tell your friends to do the same![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466900/The_Posthumous_Investigation/

notes.title: London Games Festival + Patch 0.2.2.0
notes.content:
Hey hey, professional snoopers.

Here are two updates that may be of interest to you:
[list]
[*][b]#LGF24[/b]

If you've been following our socials, you already know we're part of London Games Festival's [b]Official Selection[/b] for this year! We're thrilled to have our game featuring in physical locations overseas, and we hope Londoner aspiring detectives can find something they like in our noir Rio hills.

[i]If you haven't been following our socials, then what are you waiting for?[/i]

[*][b]Demo update[/b]

Since Next Fest, we've been hard at work organizing the rest of our development (which should take us no more than 9 months, if everything goes smoothly). Along with that, we managed to squeeze in a lot of bugfixes and polish that directly affected our demo, so we thought it would be a good opportunity to improve your experience a bit before actual release.

[i]Since we're going to be featuring in a festival very soon, might as well tidy up the place a little bit, am I right?[/i]
[/list]
I hope you enjoy Patch 0.2.2.0. If you were having any issue, give the demo another try! Maybe we fixed it. If we haven't, let us know about it through Community Hub, or our socials.

[b]And please wishlist if you still haven't![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466900/The_Posthumous_Investigation/

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1.3
notes.content:
Hey there, brave detectives!

Patch 0.2.1.3 is here, and with it a lot of style. Steam Next Fest begins today, and we thought the game could use some more polish in order for you to immerse in its atmosphere even more. Broadly speaking, you'll find:
[list]
[*] New animations: for our regular dialogues outside of interrogations, as well as background characters. For example, some folks now run from the rain, while others keep their cool thanks to their handy umbrellas!

[*] Sound: we managed to give proper attention to sound work in these past weeks. Some bugs related to that are fixed, and some characters have new music.

[*] General stability: we fixed a load of bugs, typos and dialogues, so the overall experience is considerably smoother now.
[/list]
If you already played the previous version, you'll have fun checking out our character's new facial expressions, and their new music. If you haven't, this is the moment, as we're really proud of what we achieved.

In case you encounter any issue at all, make a post in our Community Hub and we'll help you solve it.

Good luck on your posthumous investigation!

-- Victor

notes.title: The Posthumous Investigation Developer Playthrough
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, fellow detectives![/h3]

We at Mother Gaia Studio have been working hard at The Posthumous Investigation for the past 3-ish years, and we're very excited to put the game in your hands.

But before that special day comes, we wanted to show you how the game is shaping up, and decided to mark our participation in Steam's Visual Novel Fest by trying to broadcast a pre-alpha playthrough. In it, Victor ([i]me![/i]) walks through the first loop of the game while explaining the core mechanics, main inspirations, and even stumbling upon some bugs!

Come watch it to have a deeper look into our game. Or just take a glance if you don't want spoilers. It's all support, and all appreciated!

The broadcast will be streaming 24/7 during all of Visual Novel Fest, but we won't be live in chat. If you want to get in touch to ask any questions, you can comment on this post or contact us through our website and social media, and we'll get back as soon as possible.
And if all goes well, we'll also be setting up our Steam Community Hub sometime soon.

Thank you, and see you soon!

-- Victor
